title: Add cinematic or 4K at the end of your Seedance 2.0 prompt to consistently…
content:
Add cinematic or 4K at the end of your Seedance 2.0 prompt to consistently improve output quality  
Include slow motion in the prompt to get smoother, more controlled movement  
Put your subject in the first 20–30 words of the prompt because Seedance weights the beginning most  
For image-to-video, prompt only MOTION and CAMERA; don’t re-describe what’s already in the image  
Start with 5–10 second clips, lock a single shot first, then expand the sequence afterward
